messages:
maria_ae: Starting new FinInsure POC thread. Need tight acceptance criteria and cost guardrails.
ben_se: Two deliverables: user-facing summaries + reranker for claims search. Baseline traffic ~150 rps; daily import spikes ~600.
aj_devex: Proposed SLOs?
maria_ae: draft: summary p95 <= 300ms (<=512 tokens), reranker p95 <= 110ms. Cost target <= $2.5k/week for first 3 weeks; $3.5k/week cap. Quality: offline pass >= 90% on labeled set, hallucination < 1%.
sam_ml: Add metrics: usefulness mean >=4.1, factuality spot-check fail <1.5%, reranker NDCG@10 >=0.88. We'll run 1k sample offline eval.
ben_se: Security constraints? VPC + customer KMS required?
maria_ae: Yes. No external egress from model pods.
olivia_sre: Ops asks: runbook, rollback, throttling, canary rota. If they ask for audit artifacts (SOC2) we escalate — out of POC scope.
aj_devex: I'll prepare eval harness and versioned prompt set. Example run: python tools/run_eval.py --model redwood-13b-quant --prompts data/fin_insure_eval.json --metrics usefulness,factuality,ndcg
ben_se: Cost calc: avg summary ~220 tokens -> ~3.6M tokens/day at 150 rps. I'll post cost sheet.
maria_ae: Budget confirmed up to $3.5k/week cap. If costs trend high, we enable batching and fallback to quantized model.
sam_ml: Plan: start redwood-instruct-13B-quant, hold 33B as quality fallback. We'll tag outputs for manual spot checks.
aj_devex: Action items: aj_devex: eval harness + prompts (2 days); sam_ml: baseline outputs + quant profile (4 days); ben_se: cost calc + runbook PR (2 days); olivia_sre: on-call rota + rollback draft (3 days); maria_ae: confirm labeled dataset from customer (EOD tomorrow).
ben_se: Tentative timeline: artifacts ready by 2026-07-01; canary target 2026-07-07.
maria_ae: Sounds good. I'll update customer and share dataset link when ready. :thumbsup:
